claim: Pruning dead code from mbir_m2_alu.hell does not free the cells the CMP_EQ dispatch needs. A transitive dead-label analysis over all 183 labels finds exactly 6 lines (0.7% of the file) that are provably unreferenced, which is nowhere near the ~80 cells the closest attempt was short by. The arithmetic engine is already lean: the repository's 6,486-byte reclamation of increment_value was already applied.

base_image.demonstrated: loads a 7-byte stored program and executes ADD/SUB, 8/8 on both engines

method.description: Transitive dead-label analysis: a label is dead if no R_, MOVED or jump target references it, computed to a fixed point so that blocks referenced only by other dead blocks are also removed. Instruction cells such as CRAZY, ROT and NOP referenced only through their R_ forms are treated as live.
method.precedent: ALU_STATUS.md records a 6,486-byte dead-code reclamation in increment_value; that subroutine no longer exists in this image (0 occurrences)

comparison_with_need.verdict: pruning frees about 7% of what the closest attempt needs

what_this_closes: The 'prune dead code to make room' route is now measured and closed: there is no dead code left to prune that matters.
Combined with the four rejected dispatch variants (cells 58,955 / 58,969 / 57,619 / 58,152), every route the evidence has pointed to has been executed and measured.
The unified image's obstacle is the Classic 59,049-cell tape itself, given an arithmetic engine that is already lean and an initializer whose layout is non-monotonic.
what_is_demonstrated_for_b: The arithmetic half alone: mbir_m2_alu.hell, 8/8 on both engines.
The 7-byte load extension and the opcode dispatch structure assemble on the loader's andamio.
what_remains_not_demonstrated: One image that loads a stored program and executes ADD/SUB/CMP_EQ.
The 5+2 xlat2 borrow comparator in HeLL (E1 design, never built).
next_step_if_anyone_continues: A smaller arithmetic engine, not a smaller dispatch: the current one spends five result constants selected by flags plus two separate operand classifications.
Or a smaller operand domain for the comparison ({0,1,2}) so it shares a single classification.
Or accepting the 59,049-cell tape as the binding constraint.
